instruction: Please open the Chrome extensions management page in my browser. I want to review which extensions are currently installed.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome's extensions management page (chrome://extensions/). This is similar in difficulty to the original password manager navigation task - both are simple navigation to Chrome internal pages. The evaluator uses existing functions: is_expected_active_tab_approximate metric and active_url_from_accessTree getter to verify the active tab URL matches chrome://extensions/.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts the active tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric correctly compares URLs by stripping query parameters and checking for exact match with chrome://extensions/
Evaluator completely covers the instruction requirement: verify that Chrome extensions management page is opened
Expected URL value 'chrome://extensions/' is semantically correct for Chrome extensions page
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL string → metric compares to expected URL → returns 1.0 if match, 0.0 otherwise
The verification logic will work correctly at runtime using existing, tested functions
